useCase: Binary classification of real vs. AI生成的 images using 深度学习 特征
mechanism: 使用 a ResNet-50 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet, replacing the final classification layer with a binary real/AI classifier. Global Average Pooling aggregates spatial 特征 before the fully connected layer. Transfer learning enables robust 特征 extraction from limited 取证 training data.
accuracy: 高 - 88-95% on in-分布 AI generators
name: ResNet 二元分类器
source: Wang et al. (2020) - CNN-generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot For Now, CVPR
algorithm: ResNet-50 + Global Average Pooling + FC Layer
parameters: Backbone: ResNet-50, Pre-training: ImageNet, FC output: 2 (real/AI), Input: 224x224, Optimizer: Adam, Learning rate: 1e-4
description: Fine-tuned ResNet-50 deep 神经网络 trained on large-scale real vs. AI生成的 image datasets. 使用 transfer learning from ImageNet for robust 特征 extraction.

references.title: Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.
He, K. et al. (2016). Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition. CVPR.

strengths:
• Strong baseline with high 准确度
• Benefits from ImageNet pre-training
• Captures both low-level and high-level 特征
• Well-studied architecture with known properties
limitations:
• 对未见过的生成器泛化能力有限
• 新AI模型类型需要重新训练
• 黑箱特性限制了可解释性
• 容易受到对抗性攻击
